text_block_list.text:
One holiday night. Work wrapped up, 
grabbed remote, turned on TV—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"~! Look forward to spending today with 
you all♪"

Dazzling smile makes squint even through 
screen. Truly legendary top idol Haiseiko.

From captions, looks like day-in-the-life 
documentary following Haiseiko is 
starting...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko-san, thanks for hard work early 
morning! Always head to work this 
early...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Yes, pretty much! So waking up 
fully refreshed every morning is my proud 
specialty!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, let's jump right into 
first job of day~!

First, photo shoot for magazine. 
Interviews, on-street filming, meetings to 
event appearance, dance lessons well after 
sunset—

Day shown on screen one after another, 
saying "extremely busy" doesn't even begin 
to cover it.

While TV staff completely exhausted, she 
powers through schedule packed down not by 
minutes, but seconds.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *gasp*... S-Seems transit takes a 
while. Finally chance to catch breath, one 
might say—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Haiseiko-san!? U-Um, what are you 
taking notes on...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ah, this? Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: See, write daily blog for all fans, and—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Lining up tons of comments got today with 
my own super-happy feelings! Taking time 
to write them down carefully like this!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Comm—, writing...!? M-Mystery when during 
day you even found time to update blog...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Never thought you went this far... I-Isn't 
it exhausting...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: No, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"So happy!" "So fun!" "Totally blissful!" 
...Look, can tell just from my smile, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: That's all answer you need♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: That's all answer you need♪

Stared intently at smile on screen, making 
vow. Wanted to learn from this very 
resilience.

Couldn't help but smile too. That power of 
idol Haiseiko... Turned into very 
fulfilling day off.
